10721|738b752e.name: Novice Warrior
10721|738b752e.text: Are you here to prove yourself as well?

10721|a05588c0.name: Novice Warrior
10721|a05588c0.text:
<Novice Warrior gulps.>

I can do this.

1234|22acfbcb.name: Hogral Bakkan
1234|22acfbcb.text: What brings you to this part of the world, $N?

1241|4a926ca6.name: Tognus Flintfire
1241|4a926ca6.text: Good day to ye lad. Can I be of service?

1252|83b3b21e.name: Senir Whitebeard
1252|83b3b21e.text: Greetings and salutations to you, good $r. P'rhaps you'd like to share a drink with me, help fight off the chill of the wind? Come, I've more than enough to share.

1702|263b99e7.name: Bronk Guzzlegear
1702|263b99e7.text: Just a minor adjustment here... ah there we go!

2126|db7f8bbb.name: Maximillion
2126|db7f8bbb.text: It is wise that you humble yourself before me $N in your desire for more $c knowledge.

2326|a28d29e1.name: Thamner Pol
2326|a28d29e1.text: I can train you in First Aid techniques.

267279|58cf691f.name: Cadoc Winterheart
267279|58cf691f.text:
I am glad you asked!

Professions are skills pertaining to crafting, gathering, and general survival. There are many to choose from, with each offering their own unique benefits and economic opportunities. Whether you seek wealth, an opportunity to stock your guild's warehouse with useful items, or simply enjoy the satisfaction of wearing equipment crafted by your own hand; there's a profession for that.

Crafting recipes can be learned from trainers, such as those around here, and numerous other sources across Azeroth. Once learned, you can craft as many of that item as you wish, provided you can acquire the necessary materials.

267279|83e0509a.name: Cadoc Winterheart
267279|83e0509a.text:
Hello, $N! Have you considered taking up a tradeskill?

I would be happy to answer any questions you might have, or point you toward the local trainers.

If this feels overwhelming, that's okay! You can always return here or visit trainers in capital cities to get started on your crafting journey at any time.

267279|b16c6ed9.name: Cadoc Winterheart
267279|b16c6ed9.text:
Professions are divided between two main categories: primary and secondary.

You are limited to a maximum of two primary professions at a time. You can abandon your skill in a primary profession at any time, however the wealth of knowledge you gathered for it will be lost. If you choose to return to your original profession, you will need to train from the basics and seek out recipes you previously acquired to refamiliarize yourself with them.

Secondary professions do not have such limit. These skills tend to err towards self-sufficiency with your basic survival needs. You are free to train any or all of these, but may find fewer opportunities to turn a profit.

267279|b3334d4d.name: Cadoc Winterheart
267279|b3334d4d.text:
Of course! Which profession would you like me to guide you towards?

I will mark your map with the location of a local trainer of your choice. Remember that you can visit trainers in capital cities for more thorough training.

267279|e9b56518.name: Cadoc Winterheart
267279|e9b56518.text: Great choice. I have marked that location on your map.

267336|0371bf6f.name: Brighid Stormflayer
267336|0371bf6f.text: Care to learn how to gather leather from slain beasts? Or do you need some new tools?

2993|f7a5deb4.name: Baine Bloodhoof
2993|f7a5deb4.text: The land has been good to our people, $c. We must be thankful for our good fortune.

3065|2d23ed1c.name: Yaw Sharpmane
3065|2d23ed1c.text: I do not have the knowledge you seek.

3066|1605f087.name: Narm Skychaser
3066|1605f087.text: The spirits have guided you to me. How may I be of service?

3067|0c543544.name: Pyall Silentstride
3067|0c543544.text: Cooking is a life long pursuit and I see we share the same passion!

3067|b48f927f.name: Pyall Silentstride
3067|b48f927f.text: I can teach you how to cook!

3222|4dab2020.name: Brave Wildrunner
3222|4dab2020.text: While we have no Alchemy Trainer here in Bloodhoof Village, there is one in Thunder Bluff to the north.  Follow the road there and ask one of the Bluffwatchers for directions when you get to the top.

3222|b41a2ca2.name: Brave Wildrunner
3222|b41a2ca2.text: You are looking for Uthan Stillwater.  You will find him west of the village, fishing at Stonebull Lake.

5938|c2467ddc.name: Uthan Stillwater
5938|c2467ddc.text: I can teach you fishing skills.

6747|e013de07.name: Innkeeper Kauth
6747|e013de07.text: As the wind on the plains, you are always welcome here.

714|7dd450ba.name: Talin Keeneye
714|7dd450ba.text: Greetings, $c! Fine day for hunting, wouldn't you say? I've been having more than a little luck with boars, myself. Perhaps you'd like a shot?

786|b76e4f1a.name: Grelin Whitebeard
786|b76e4f1a.text: Greetings, lad. I'm Grelin Whitebeard. I'm here to examine the threat posed by the growing numbers of trolls in Coldridge Valley. What have I found? It's a bit troubling...

836|b62f5856.name: Durnan Furcutter
836|b62f5856.text: I sell the finest cloth and leather garb this side of the valley!

916|4968a15c.name: Solm Hargrin
916|4968a15c.text: What kin I do for ye, $N?

1470-accept.name: Venya Marthand
1470-accept.text:
Greetings, child. I can see that you are still young in the ways of the $c, power still eluding your grasp. I can sense your eagerness to learn.

And you will learn.

There is no strength in ignorance. Knowledge is our greatest power. Through its application, we can control the chaotic magics and beings of the void, bending them to our will.

I will show you how to bind a servant to your will, but first you must bring me three skulls of the rattlecage skeletons near the abandoned smithy.
1470-accept.title: Piercing the Veil

1470-complete.name: Venya Marthand
1470-complete.text:
Though you are still untested and young in your learning, you have proven that you possess sufficient ability to master the summoning and binding of an imp. Do not be deceived by an imp's size. Though it lacks physical strength, it possesses powers and a cleverness that will serve you well.

Attend me carefully, $N, for I will not repeat this lesson, and I will leave its mastery to you.
1470-complete.title: Piercing the Veil

1470-progress.name: Venya Marthand
1470-progress.text:
Your power is little now, though I suspect already you sense the possibilities.

Even the dead might feel alive, with that power coursing through us.
1470-progress.title: Piercing the Veil

1656-complete.name: Innkeeper Kauth
1656-complete.text:
Ah, the furs I was expecting. Thank you.

These came faster than I had expected. They will make good blankets for anyone who wishes to stay here.

Please feel free to stay as long as you like. My inn is always open and all of our people are welcome here. And don't underestimate a good night's rest, it can make a great difference while you're out traveling.
1656-complete.title: A Task Unfinished

1656-progress.name: Innkeeper Kauth
1656-progress.text:
Yes, young one? What can Kauth do for you?

The journey here from the Mesa can be a tremendous burden for some, but a welcome sight for others. Which is it for you, I wonder?
1656-progress.title: A Task Unfinished

170-accept.name: Balir Frosthammer
170-accept.text:
I hope you're here to lend us a hand, $c. After the last trogg attack, we could use all the help we can get.

I hear the buggers have been popping up all across the lands, and it seems Coldridge Valley is no exception. They've been spotted all over the hills to the southeast and near the frozen lake.

And that's not all, just a few nights ago, they attacked and overran our camp to the west! 

We're a bit shorthanded here, lad, and we need strong arms to help drive the troggs back.
170-accept.title: A New Threat

170-complete.name: Balir Frosthammer
170-complete.text: If the problems we've had here are indicative of what is happening elsewhere in our lands, by Magni's beard, we have some troubles ahead of us! I can only hope that the king and Senate are taking steps to deal with the threat the troggs pose.
170-complete.title: A New Threat

179-complete.name: Sten Stoutarm
179-complete.text: Ah! Wonderful. The wolf meat should do nicely. Oh, don't worry, $N, I wouldn't forget my part of the bargain. Here, one of these should fit you.
179-complete.title: Dwarven Outfitters

179-progress.name: Sten Stoutarm
179-progress.text: Wolves giving you a bit of trouble? You'd do well to avoid the fangs and claws and other sharp bits, yes?
179-progress.title: Dwarven Outfitters

18-progress.name: Deputy Willem
18-progress.text: Have you gathered those bandanas for me yet?
18-progress.title: Brotherhood of Thieves

182-accept.name: Grelin Whitebeard
182-accept.text:
My brother Senir and I were sent to different parts of Dun Morogh to investigate the threat posed by the trolls. The Senate has its hands full with the troggs, so they've no need for further annoyances.

From what I've seen, the trolls aren't well situated here in Coldridge Valley--mostly the southern cave. I'd say that the army will not be necessary. A few strong arms should be more than enough.

Perhaps you'd like to assist in this endeavor? I have the authority to offer compensation for your help.
182-accept.title: The Troll Cave

182-complete.name: Grelin Whitebeard
182-complete.text:
Argh! Those Light-blasted trolls!

<He takes a few breaths and seems to settle down... a bit.>

A group of them came in the night and stole my journal! I knew better than to trust that good-for-nothing appr...
182-complete.title: The Troll Cave

183-accept.name: Talin Keeneye
183-accept.text:
Nothing like a day of boar hunting, eh?

Though, here in Coldridge Valley, there are so many boars it almost takes the fun out of it. No need to get them charging. They're all angry and ready without any help. In fact, recently, there've been so many boars in the area, it's become dangerous for me to do my daily hunting.

Long story short, if you could help me kill some of the boars, I would appreciate it.
183-accept.title: The Boar Hunter

183-complete.name: Talin Keeneye
183-complete.text: Excellent! I can go back to my... leisurely... hunting now. Thank you, $N.
183-complete.title: The Boar Hunter

2160-accept.name: Hands Springsprocket
2160-accept.text:
Hey! You look like a hearty adventurer. If you're planning on braving the pass, do you suppose you could bring a package to the inn in Kharanos?

You were planning on stopping at the inn, right? If you make it through the pass, you'll definitely want to take a breather there.

Anyways, bring this to Tannok Frosthammer, the innkeeper's assistant. I can't get through the pass myself, and it'll be days until a Mountaineer escort comes through!
2160-accept.title: Supplies to Tannok

2160-complete.name: Tannok Frosthammer
2160-complete.text:
Ah, at last, the supplies from Hands! I was beginning to worry, we've had scarce word from Anvilmar ever since the troggs overran the pass.

Thanks for bringing this to me, $N. And please, make yourself comfortable. You must be tired after your journey.
2160-complete.title: Supplies to Tannok

2160-progress.name: Tannok Frosthammer
2160-progress.text: Hi there! Come in, take a seat by the fire and warm yourself with a flagon of ale.
2160-progress.title: Supplies to Tannok

218-accept.name: Grelin Whitebeard
218-accept.text:
My journal! They took it away to the cave. The one that had it... It was a big brute with some odd markings on his skin and face. I didn't get a much better look than that.

You've had some luck with the trolls, maybe you could go get it back for me?
218-accept.title: The Stolen Journal

218-complete.name: Grelin Whitebeard
218-complete.text:
Wonderful, $N! Many thanks for retrieving my notebook. Well, it would seem that the troll situation here in Coldridge Valley is under control and not much cause for worry.

After I put the finishing touches on my report, I'll need someone to courier it to my brother Senir.
218-complete.title: The Stolen Journal

233-accept.name: Sten Stoutarm
233-accept.text:
Hm, I don't suppose you'd be willing to do a favor for me, lad? A stack of letters came through the pass today, but I don't have the time to send them along.

They're all addressed to Talin Keeneye. You can find him to the west down the road. He's set up camp next to the frozen lake.

What do you say?
233-accept.title: Coldridge Valley Mail Delivery

233-complete.name: Talin Keeneye
233-complete.text:
Thank you, I've been waiting for these letters for quite some time...

Unfortunately, these letters aren't all for me. This one is addressed to Grelin Whitebeard. He's not too far away if you'd like to deliver it to him.
233-complete.title: Coldridge Valley Mail Delivery

233-progress.name: Talin Keeneye
233-progress.text: Yes? Do you have something for me?
233-progress.title: Coldridge Valley Mail Delivery

234-accept.name: Talin Keeneye
234-accept.text: If I remember correctly, Grelin's camp is down the road to the southeast. No doubt he'll be eager to get his mail.
234-accept.title: Coldridge Valley Mail Delivery

234-complete.name: Grelin Whitebeard
234-complete.text: Ahh, excellent. It's been a while since I received word from Ironforge. Ach, these letters from me mum warm my heart. Here, not fair you don't get some readin', too. Take one of these manuals we have lyin' around.
234-complete.title: Coldridge Valley Mail Delivery

234-progress.name: Grelin Whitebeard
234-progress.text: Is there something I can help you with?
234-progress.title: Coldridge Valley Mail Delivery

282-accept.name: Grelin Whitebeard
282-accept.text:
I was planning on sending my apprentice to my brother Senir with my report, but I would feel much better were it placed in more... reliable hands. That is, of course, if you wouldn't mind?

Hmm... you'll have to take the tunnel to get to Kharanos.

Speak with Mountaineer Thalos before going through the tunnel. It's completely infested with troggs now.

Follow the road back to Anvilmar, then keep heading east to the tunnel, Thalos is stationed nearby.
282-accept.title: Senir's Observations

282-complete.name: Mountaineer Thalos
282-complete.text:
Hm, well, if Whitebeard is sending you to Dun Morogh on important business, I can't very well stop you, can I?

At least let me provide you with some advice and directions.
282-complete.title: Senir's Observations

282-progress.name: Mountaineer Thalos
282-progress.text:
Hail! Have a care, $N, the tunnel to Dun Morogh is infested with troggs and is not safe for travel.

If you haven't any pressing business in Dun Morogh, I'll have to ask you to remain in Anvilmar until the tunnel is safer.
282-progress.title: Senir's Observations

3104-progress.name: Khelden Bremen
3104-progress.text: Hello, $N. I am Khelden. Is there something I can do for you?
3104-progress.title: Glyphic Letter

3109-accept.name: Sten Stoutarm
3109-accept.text: While you were helping me out, this rune was given to me to pass on to you. Take some time to read it when you have a chance. I'm thinkin' it came from the $c trainer Solm. Take a gander at it and go find him inside Anvilmar when you've a chance.
3109-accept.title: Encrypted Rune

3109-complete.name: Solm Hargrin
3109-complete.text:
Anyway, as you start peekin' around Coldridge you'll probably have need of training at some point. You just come back to me whenever you feel you need it and I'll teach you what I know--a trick here, a maneuver there. You know, the stuff that keeps you alive and makin' a little extra coin.

Keep an eye out on our gnomish friends too... they kinda got the short end of the stick what with Gnomeregan being... destroyed. They'll need our help to feel welcome.
3109-complete.title: Encrypted Rune

3109-progress.name: Solm Hargrin
3109-progress.text:
You made it! Great!

We've got an influx of activity lately, so I'm glad to count another of the Ironforge clan among our numbers. Nothin' like a cold blade in your hand and a shadow to keep you one step ahead, and if you're here, you know exactly what I mean!
3109-progress.title: Encrypted Rune

313-accept.name: Pilot Stonegear
313-accept.text:
Driving a Siege Engine isn't for everyone.  It takes an iron grip and nerves of steel...lucky I have both!  How about you?  How's your mettle?  Want to prove it to me?

Well...I'm looking to make my engine, Trollplow, a little more cozy.  How about you get me a heap of Wendigo Manes from the Grizzled Den, west of Kharanos.  Those manes would make a great rug for Trollplow's inside deck!
313-accept.title: The Grizzled Den

317-accept.name: Pilot Bellowfiz
317-accept.text:
I'm preparing to start a mission for the Siege Brigade.  It's a long one, and I need to stock Jetsteam with a month's worth of supplies.  So while Steelgrill is working on my tank, can you do some hunting for me?

I'll need some fur for bedding, and boar meat for food.  You can get meat from boars and fur from the bears... you can find them both in the snow fields south of the Grizzled Den.
317-accept.title: Stocking Jetsteam

33-progress.name: Eagan Peltskinner
33-progress.text: Hey $N.  I'm getting hungry...did you get that tough wolf meat?
33-progress.title: Wolves Across the Border

3361-accept.name: Felix Whindlebolt
3361-accept.text:
We drove the troggs out of Gnomeregan, but then it all went so horribly wrong!  Now our home is completely irradiated, and we gnomes have been scattered all over Dun Morogh.

In my haste to get away from the radiation, I lost all my personal belongings and tools.  It was the trolls that got them.  They stole my chest, my box, and my bucket of bolts!  They took them back to their camps southwest of Anvilmar.

I'm no adventurer - could you find my things and bring them here to me, please?
3361-accept.title: A Refugee's Quandary

3361-complete.name: Felix Whindlebolt
3361-complete.text: Huzzah, you've found them!  You're an absolute savior, my friend.  Here, it's not much, but it's something for the trouble I've put you through!  Thank you!
3361-complete.title: A Refugee's Quandary

3361-progress.name: Felix Whindlebolt
3361-progress.text:
Oh goodness $N, this town is not well suited for the likes of me.  There are as many nasty creatures here as there were in Gnomeregan before the accident!

Do you have my belongings?  If you don't, then who knows what the trolls have done with them now...
3361-progress.title: A Refugee's Quandary

3364-accept.name: Nori Pridedrift
3364-accept.text:
Gah!  I was supposed to get this delicious scalding mornbrew to Durnan Furcutter inside Anvilmar a while ago now, but I had to deliver one to Grelin here first.  I'll never make it to Anvilmar before the brew runs cold!

You look fast.  Maybe you can make it.  This cup will only stay hot for five more minutes, and Durnan didn't order "chilly" mornbrew, so get going.  Anvilmar is to the northeast, a settlement dug into the mountain.

Thanks, $N, and don't forget to bring me back my mug!
3364-accept.title: Scalding Mornbrew Delivery

3364-complete.name: Durnan Furcutter
3364-complete.text: Ah good, now this will hit the spot.  Allow me to take a small break while I enjoy this scalding mornbrew!
3364-complete.title: Scalding Mornbrew Delivery

3364-progress.name: Durnan Furcutter
3364-progress.text: Aye, I'm Durnan Furcutter.  You have something for me?
3364-progress.title: Scalding Mornbrew Delivery

3365-accept.name: Durnan Furcutter
3365-accept.text:
Now that hit the spot!  Nothing like a piping hot - nay, SCALDING mornbrew on a cold winter's day to warm your cackles of yer soul.

Here ya go $N - be a pal and take this empty mug back to Nori for me, would ya now.
3365-accept.title: Bring Back the Mug

3365-complete.name: Nori Pridedrift
3365-complete.text:
Excellent, $N!  You'd be surprised how many couriers I meet who forget to do something as simple as bring back the mug.  Mugs don't grow on trees, or so they tell me!

Here's a little something for the effort.  Thanks again for your help.
3365-complete.title: Bring Back the Mug

3365-progress.name: Nori Pridedrift
3365-progress.text: I trust the scalding mornbrew got to Durnan on time!  Did you remember to bring me back my mug?
3365-progress.title: Bring Back the Mug

363-accept.name: Undertaker Mordo
363-accept.text:
About time you woke up. We were ready to toss you into the fire with the others, but it looks like you made it.

I am Mordo, the caretaker of the crypt of Deathknell. And you are the Lich King's slave no more.

Speak with Shadow Priest Sarvis in the chapel at the base of the hill, he will tell you more of what you must know.
363-accept.title: Rude Awakening

363-complete.name: Shadow Priest Sarvis
363-complete.text:
Another of the walking dead, hm? Must have been quite a shock, waking up in the crypt with only the cold and Mordo to greet you...

I see the confusion on your face. Let me try to explain our... situation... to you.

We have been freed from the control of the Lich King by our new leader, Lady Sylvanas. The Dark Lady guides us in our war against the hated Scourge and the holdouts of humanity who dog our every step.
363-complete.title: Rude Awakening

364-accept.name: Shadow Priest Sarvis
364-accept.text:
We Forsaken are at war with the Lich King's army of the Scourge: necromantically raised armies of the $r, foul beasts of the north, and tormented spectres.

The northern part of the village has become overrun with the Mindless Ones, and they must be destroyed. Destroy them, show them no mercy, our former brothers and sisters as they might be. The Fallen are nothing but The Lich King's slaves.
364-accept.title: The Mindless Ones

384-accept.name: Ragnar Thunderbrew
384-accept.text:
Nothing my tavern patrons enjoy more than some Beer Basted Boar Ribs!  Only problem is, the local trapper who used to bring me supplies enlisted in the King's Army to help with the war on the Alliance front. 

Maybe you can help me out?  If you bring me six crag boar ribs and a Rhapsody Malt from the tavern here, I'll give you the family recipe for my famous Beer Basted Boar Ribs, not to mention a free sample!  The secret's in the Malt!
384-accept.title: Beer Basted Boar Ribs

3905-progress.name: Brother Neals
3905-progress.text: You look to be in fine spirits!  Come!  Have a seat, and have a drink!
3905-progress.title: Grape Manifest

400-accept.name: Tharek Blackstone
400-accept.text:
Beldin Steelgrill owns the local mechanic shop, and he's the best siege engine tech there is!  But he's not forgiving to his tools.  I swear he almost breaks more arclight spanners than we can supply him with!

We just filled his last order for tools.  If you deliver it to him I'm sure he'll make it worth the effort.

His shop, Steelgrill's Depot, is just northeast of Kharanos.  And it's a local haunt for veteran siege engine pilots, so keep your ears open for opportunities while you're there.
400-accept.title: Tools for Steelgrill

400-complete.name: Beldin Steelgrill
400-complete.text:
You have my tools?  Well done, lad, well done!  I just broke my last fang-ratchet an hour ago and I need one of those to finish repairs on Pilot Stonegear's siege engine.  You did a good thing by lugging those tools here, $N.

Here, take these coins for your help.
400-complete.title: Tools for Steelgrill

400-progress.name: Beldin Steelgrill
400-progress.text:
Hm?  You look a little young to be a siege engine pilot.  But no matter...do you need something fixed?

Well take a number and get comfortable.  I'm working on a couple engines right now and won't have time for another job for at least a few days.

Or, were you here for something else...?
400-progress.title: Tools for Steelgrill

420-accept.name: Mountaineer Thalos
420-accept.text:
The troggs in the tunnel are extremely hostile, and haven't shown any hesitation in attacking travelers through the tunnel. You seem tough enough, though, so you should probably be safe.

Directions? If you're going to speak with Senir, you'll find him in Kharanos.

Make your way through the tunnel, and after you come out on the other side, just keep following the road, it'll run right into Kharanos.
420-accept.title: Senir's Observations

420-complete.name: Senir Whitebeard
420-complete.text:
What's this? Ah, my brother's report. Hmm...

I told him to be sparing with the use of the King's name, but he didn't listen. No harm, I suppose, though it's sure to ruffle some feathers in the Senate. Not that those weren't some feathers that needed ruffling! Hah!

Nonetheless, I guess that means that I should send my report on to Ironforge as well, but I must admit I'm a bit behind. Bloody cold.

I should have some work for you later, if you're interested.
420-complete.title: Senir's Observations

420-progress.name: Senir Whitebeard
420-progress.text: How are you? Like to share a drink with me, perhaps? Not much else to do in the cold.
420-progress.title: Senir's Observations

54-progress.name: Marshal Dughan
54-progress.text:
You have word from McBride?  Northshire is a garden compared to Elwynn Forest, but I wonder what Marshal McBride has to report.

Here, let me have his papers...
54-progress.title: Report to Goldshire

5541-accept.name: Loslor Rudge
5541-accept.text:
Hegnar Rumbleshot sells guns off the road to Anvilmar.  Riflemen and mortar teams spend a lot of time practicing out near his shop, and he's always needing fresh ammunition.

But... the last crate of ammo I sent him got lost along the way.  My courier said he was camped near the Grizzled Den when wendigo chased him away... and the fool left Rumbleshot's ammo behind!

$N, can you get that ammo and take it to Rumbleshot?  He's been waiting on it and I'm sure he's running low.
5541-accept.title: Ammo for Rumbleshot

6-progress.name: Deputy Willem
6-progress.text: Did you find Garrick's shack?  Are we finally free of that villain?
6-progress.title: Bounty on Garrick Padfoot

743-accept.name: Ruul Eagletalon
743-accept.text:
Thank you for taking the time to speak to me, $N. I am Ruul, warrior and teacher.

You have obviously reached an age when you must prepare for your trials if you are to adventure much further out of Mulgore.

If you wish a test of your strength, start by seeking out the Windfury harpies to the southeast. They nestle along the mountain's edges away from the road.

They are one of our natural enemies here in Mulgore and will be a good gauge of your skill.
743-accept.title: Dangers of the Windfury

745-accept.name: Baine Bloodhoof
745-accept.text:
$N, there are many conflicts that wound this land. It is my hope that you will not bear witness to as many of them as I have. Yet there is one that I would ask you to seek out. It will give you some sense of how terrible, if left unchecked, even a small threat can be to the land.

Palemane gnolls have settled to the south of Bloodhoof and in a cave to the west. They disrespect our attempts to communicate with them, and they slay the wildlife of Mulgore unbridled.

Words are no longer the answer.
745-accept.title: Sharing the Land

746-accept.name: Baine Bloodhoof
746-accept.text:
There are dwarves preparing a dig site to the northwest.  They think secrets lie in the earth, and that is true, but hollowing and defiling the land is no way to earn its teachings.

Collect the dwarven tools of digging, smash them, and return to me with the dwarves' broken tools.

You can smash the tools at a forge.  You will find one in Thunder Bluff, but any forge -- even a forge at the dwarven camp -- will suffice.
746-accept.title: Dwarven Digging

748-accept.name: Mull Thunderhorn
748-accept.text:
Goblins and their servants have tainted our sacred water wells! We cannot allow this.

To cleanse each well, I must create a cleansing totem, then you must bring the totem to the well and perform a cleansing ritual.

First we will create a cleansing totem for the Winterhoof Water Well. To do this, the land must offer its aid. Hunt prairie wolves for their paws and adult plainstriders for their talons. They are to the southwest.

Return to me with the paws and talons, $N.
748-accept.title: Poison Water

761-accept.name: Harken Windtotem
761-accept.text:
The swoop is a cunning bird, and difficult to find and hunt.  A collection of Swoop Quills is a badge of cleverness and determination for a hunter.

If you are willing to take up this task, then enter the plains and hunt the swoop.

Bring me their quills, and bring honor to your clan.

The swoops may be found anywhere in Mulgore, but your eyes must be sharp to spot them, and your hooves must be quick to catch them.
761-accept.title: Swoop Hunting

763-complete.name: Baine Bloodhoof
763-complete.text: Word from my good friend, Chief Hawkwind! Ah, I can see by his carvings you are of a special breed.
763-complete.title: Rites of the Earthmother

763-progress.name: Baine Bloodhoof
763-progress.text: What brings you to my village, $c?
763-progress.title: Rites of the Earthmother

766-accept.name: Maur Raincaller
766-accept.text:
My grandfather told me stories about his battles with a strider named Mazzranache. He told me of its demonic red eyes, razor-sharp talons and venomous bite.

As fortune would have it, while traveling across the plains, I encountered it, and it took a nasty bite from my shoulder. He was as terrible as my grandfather described. I will need some hard-to-find animal parts to clean the infection from his bite: a wolf heart, cougar femur, plainstrider scale and swoop gizzard.

Hurry, time is of the essence.
766-accept.title: Mazzranache

767-accept.name: Baine Bloodhoof
767-accept.text:
The Rite of Vision, one of the Rites of the Earthmother, will help guide you toward earning the respect of the elders of Thunder Bluff.

Our people have learned that the land is our most holy provider. In order to take part in the ritualistic vision, you must speak with the spiritual leader of the village, Zarlman Two-Moons.
767-accept.title: Rite of Vision

767-complete.name: Zarlman Two-Moons
767-complete.text: I sensed you would be coming to me, $c. I can always recognize one who is trying to pass the Rites of the Earthmother.
767-complete.title: Rite of Vision

771-accept.name: Zarlman Two-Moons
771-accept.text:
In order to pass through the Rite of Vision, you must gather the reagents needed to make the Water of the Seers.

I will need well stones, which can be found around the water wells in Mulgore. With those I will combine Ambercorn, which fall beneath the mighty trees in our land.

These reagents contain magical elements, and when brewed and consumed before the tribal fire, will cause you to encounter a vision. Follow it, and it will lead you to the next step of this holy quest.
771-accept.title: Rite of Vision

91741-progress.name: Brother Paxton
91741-progress.text: What's that you got there? It looks like one of my books.
91741-progress.title: Nibbled-On Book

91743-progress.name: Brother Paxton
91743-progress.text: Have you rescued my books yet, $N?!
91743-progress.title: Rascally Rodents

91752-progress.name: Marshal McBride
91752-progress.text: Have you retrieved those stolen books yet?
91752-progress.title: The Big Picture

91772-progress.name: Marshal Dughan
91772-progress.text: Have you figured out where the Kobolds are heading?
91772-progress.title: Shhh! We're Hunting Kobolds

95998-accept.name: Sam Sarsaparilla
95998-accept.text:
Well howdy there, $c. I can see you've got the look of an adventurer about you. Good for you. The world needs more of us restless souls, seeking fortune and glory.

It's a big wide world out there and you'll need to learn to thrive in the wilds to be successful. Not sure how your outdoorsman skills are but I reckon I could teach you a thing or two, if you'd be apt to learn.

Have a seat near the fire, get comfy. I'll walk you through it.
95998-accept.title: The Great Outdoors

96047-accept.name: Eric Brighthammer
96047-accept.text:
So you've taken up First Aid? That's an honorable... and pragmatic pursuit as a $c.

I reckon I know someone that can teach you how to craft a First Aid Kit for your camp. Injuries are a reality in the world of adventuring and offering some much-needed healing at your camp could even save lives.
96047-accept.title: Camping 101: First Aid

96130-accept.name: Yaw Sharpmane
96130-accept.text:
Among the prairie wolves that hunt the hills nearby is one that is especially aggressive. We have taken to calling her Chakuyak. She has become a threat to travelers coming from abroad.

She stalks the trees west of Stonebull Lake, moving from tree stand to tree stand.

End this threat and bring me her pelt, and I will speak your praises to the chief. Beware, for she is dangerous! You might see other hunters seeking her out there, and perhaps you could work as a team.
96130-accept.title: Chakuyak

96608-accept.name: Eric Brighthammer
96608-accept.text:
Greetings, $c. I can see you've got the look of an adventurer about you. This is good. The world needs more of us restless souls, seeking fortune and glory.

You'll need to learn to thrive in the wilds to be successful in this line of work. Not sure how your outdoor skills are but I can probably teach you a thing or two, if you'd be apt to learn.

Have a seat near the fire and get comfortable. I'll walk you through it.
96608-accept.title: The Great Outdoors

96626-accept.name: Sam Sarsaparilla
96626-accept.text:
So you want to learn more about camping, huh? Good for you, $c. The first step any adventurer needs to take is to become a cook and learn how to make a campfire.

Cooking's not just about making tasty foods. It's also the foundation for your camp.
96626-accept.title: Camping 101: Cooking

96627-complete.name: Sam Sarsaparilla
96627-complete.text:
I appreciate the lookin' out, $c. That marshal's just a worrywart.

Hey, you've got the look of an adventurer yourself. How would you like to learn about camping?
96627-complete.title: The Adventurer

96628-accept.name: Mountaineer Thalos
96628-accept.text:
Wait, $N. I have another ask of you, before you brave that tunnel.

My mountaineers have reported an adventurer that's shown up just outside of Kharanos. Could you deliver these supplies to him?
96628-accept.title: The Adventurer

96628-complete.name: Eric Brighthammer
96628-complete.text:
You say these are from the mountaineers? Aye, I could use them. Thank you, $c.

Hey, you've got the look of an adventurer yourself. How would you like to learn about camping?
96628-complete.title: The Adventurer

96628-progress.name: Eric Brighthammer
96628-progress.text: Are you here to learn about camping in the wilderness?
96628-progress.title: The Adventurer

96629-accept.name: Eric Brighthammer
96629-accept.text:
So you want to learn more about camping, huh? Good for you, $c. The first step any adventurer needs to take is to become a cook and learn how to make a campfire.

Cooking's not just about making tasty foods. It's also the foundation for your camp.
96629-accept.title: Camping 101: Cooking

96661-complete.name: Pyall Silentstride
96661-complete.text:
With this, you'll be able to set up a camp anywhere out in the wilderness. What you've learned is just the basics, so you won't be able to place too many furnishings around it.

Raise your cooking skill and you might just be able to learn to make even bigger fires.

You can also learn the basics of furnishing your campsites from other tradeskill trainers if you're savvy in their skills.
96661-complete.title: Camping 101: Cooking

97277-accept.name: Grund Drokda
97277-accept.text:
Oi, had me back turned gettin' the boar roast ready when I heard me pal Gozwin screamin' fer his life!

Wicked fangs and a blur are all I saw when I turned. Such huge paws! A snow leopard was draggin' its gnomish catch away. I grabbed me shotgun and fired above the beast. It dropped him and sprinted off.

Luckily, it hadn't done more than give ol' Goz some deep scratches.

Head back to camp in the northwestern hills and retrieve Gozwin's Mechanic's Log. Kill that snow leopard too if you see it!
97277-accept.title: Grund and Gozwin

97277-complete.name: Grund Drokda
97277-complete.text:
Aye, I'm not surprised to hear that snow leopard was makin' a meal of the boar we were fixin' fer roastin'!

Goz will have one less thing to stress about now that you brought back his log book. Maybe now he can focus all his energy on gettin' back on his feet.

Thanks, $N. Take a little something as a token of my appreciation, fer makin' the trek, and fer protectin' the hills.
97277-complete.title: Grund and Gozwin

97277-progress.name: Grund Drokda
97277-progress.text: Poor Goz is more concerned for his mecha-walker than himself. Says if anyone gets a hold of that mechanic's log he's greased. Hah! That's why I told him he should just leave his work at home!
97277-progress.title: Grund and Gozwin

97921-accept.name: Sam Sarsaparilla
97921-accept.text:
Looks to me like you've gained some skill in herbalism. Picking flowers isn't just for dilly-dallying, you know. It can be useful... and profitable.

I reckon I know someone that can teach you how to craft an Incense Candle for your camp. High spirits are a key component to keeping healers and spellcasters in the fight, and an Incense Candle can provide a boost that magic users will surely appreciate.
97921-accept.title: Camping 101: Herbalism

98321-accept.name: Tognus Flintfire
98321-accept.text:
Hoha! Good to see a $r who's not afraid to get their hands dirty.

If yer lookin' fer work, I'm afraid I'm a little short on supplies at the moment. Our most reliable source of ore has been overrun by wendigo and now the cave has been abandoned. The miners had to drop everything when they fled!

Say, why don't ye poke yer head around the Grizzled Den to the west and see if you can find some of our missing shipments. It would save us a great deal o' trouble.
98321-accept.title: Flintfire's Shipment

98322-accept.name: Senir Whitebeard
98322-accept.text:
Spelunking dark caves is adventurer business. My job's just to make reports and send them over to Ironforge.

Trouble is, one of my reports hasn't... well, reported back. I asked a few mountaineers to learn more about the wendigo problem we have out here, but I haven't heard from them.

If you're already going to be out and about, what say you don't check in with Mountaineer Gretchen just west of town. I'm late enough as it is!
98322-accept.title: Secure the Mountain

99079-accept.name: Brave Wildrunner
99079-accept.text:
The Longwalkers are our people's most trusted scouts. Though their loyalty lies with the High Chieftain alone, young Baine at times seeks their aid.

This is one such time. Longwalker Malah was dispatched near our borders to the east and did not return last night after three days. When this occurs, it is our duty to confirm their safety.

I must ensure the village remains safe. Prove yourself, and seek Malah out. You will know her by her headband and feathered staff, emblematic of the Longwalkers.
99079-accept.title: Longwalker Malah

99080-accept.name: Baine Bloodhoof
99080-accept.text:
Hear my words well: we will not yield a single blade of grass to the centaur.

Go to their camp now, before they have rested and have a chance to ride to our village. Slaughter them all. Ensure none escape to the Barrens to rally others to their aid.

If you find the leader of this would-be raiding party, bring me his head so that it may serve as a warning to others who dare tread on our ancestral homeland.
99080-accept.title: Drive Them Out

99081-complete.name: Brave Wildrunner
99081-complete.text: This is most dire news indeed. We must inform Baine at once!
99081-complete.title: Grim Tidings

99101-accept.name: Brave Wildrunner
99101-accept.text:
Baine Bloodhoof leads our village. He must know of this incursion at once.

Bring him Longwalker Malah's report. You will find him at the center of town.

Quickly, now. There is no time to waste!
99101-accept.title: Our Ancient Enemy

99101-complete.name: Baine Bloodhoof
99101-complete.text:
<Baine reads the report, his gaze darkening.>

This will not stand. Thank you for delivering it to me, $N.
99101-complete.title: Our Ancient Enemy

99101-progress.name: Baine Bloodhoof
99101-progress.text: What is it you bring me, $c?
99101-progress.title: Our Ancient Enemy

99108-accept.name: Krang Stonehoof
99108-accept.text:
Hail, young $c. Though you are not a warrior and I cannot teach you that path, that does not mean you would not benefit from my tutelage.

Before you lies the arena. In it, it matters not who you call mother or whether you wield sword or bow. All are equal, and all learn to sharpen their horns in direct combat.

Will you enter our space, and learn our ways for yourself? You may face any of these novices, or any other willing adversary. I care not which.
99108-accept.title: Sparring Match

99108-complete.name: Krang Stonehoof
99108-complete.text:
You honor me with your abilities, $c. Perhaps the new generation has hope yet.

Take these to tend to your wounds, for many more battles await you in this harsh world.
99108-complete.title: Sparring Match

99158-accept.name: Maxan Anvol
99158-accept.text:
There's a priest out in the mountains that belongs to an organization called the Argent Dawn. They're a holy group that is dedicated to finding and destroying the unholy and unnatural.

Father Gavin though, he's mostly the type that seeks to help and heal everyone rather than grab a weapon. He's fixed up an old building to serve as a rest spot for travelers and called it Misty Pine Refuge. I've got a shipment of holy candles that I need to get him. Could you bring them to him if your going that way?
99158-accept.title: Dawn in the Mountains

99158-progress.name: Father Gavin
99158-progress.text: Why did the Light guide you here today?
99158-progress.title: Dawn in the Mountains

99159-progress.name: Father Gavin
99159-progress.text: Light guide you on your tasks.
99159-progress.title: Finding Warmth
